title: Rust: Database Operations
description: Implement an in-memory database with CRUD operations and querying.

steps.title: Define Database Schema
steps.description: Define a `Row` struct with `id: i32, name: String, age: i32, email: String`. Create an in-memory `Database` that stores rows in a `HashMap<i32, Row>`. Add 3 sample rows and print them.
hints: `struct Row { id: i32, name: String, age: i32, email: String }`
`struct Database { rows: HashMap<i32, Row>, next_id: i32 }`

verification.failureMessage: Create database with 3 sample rows and print them.

steps.title: CRUD Operations
steps.description: Implement `insert`, `select`, `update`, and `delete` methods on Database. Insert a new row, select it by ID, update its name, then delete it. Print results after each operation.
hints: `insert(row: Row) -> i32` inserts and returns new ID.

verification.failureMessage: Demonstrate all four CRUD operations and print results.

steps.title: Query Filtering
steps.description: Implement a `query` method that accepts a predicate closure `Fn(&Row) -> bool`. Filter rows where age > 25. Print matching rows.
hints:
`fn query

(&self, predicate: P) -> Vec<&Row> where P: Fn(&Row) -> bool { self.rows.values().filter(|r| predicate(r)).collect() }`

verification.failureMessage: Query rows with age > 25 and print them.

steps.title: Join Tables
steps.description: Create a second table `Orders` (order_id, user_id, product, amount). Implement a join operation that combines users with their orders. Print each user with their orders.
hints: `struct Order { order_id: i32, user_id: i32, product: String, amount: f64 }`
Join: for each user, find orders where order.user_id == user.id.

verification.failureMessage: Join users with orders and print combined results.

steps.title: Transaction Support
steps.description: Implement a simple transaction system: `begin_transaction` creates a savepoint, `commit` applies changes, `rollback` reverts to savepoint. Demonstrate a successful transaction and a rolled-back one.
hints: On `commit`, discard the saved state (changes are permanent).
On `rollback`, restore the saved state (changes discarded).

verification.failureMessage: Demonstrate both committed and rolled-back transactions.
